close_reason: Prefix header length as 4-byte big-endian u32 before hashing to prevent split-ambiguity collisions
description: cid_for_article in crates/core/src/ipld/cid_util.rs SHA-256-hashes header_bytes ++ body_bytes with no separator. Two articles with header/body split at different offsets but identical concatenated bytes (e.g. header='AB',body='C' vs header='A',body='BC') produce the same canonical CID, silently aliasing distinct articles. The dual-CID model's dedup guarantee depends on this CID being collision-free for distinct articles. Fix: insert a fixed-length length prefix or a sentinel separator byte between header_bytes and body_bytes before hashing.
title: cid_for_article: no separator causes length-extension collision
